title: Homeowner Refund Percent on a Homesite Reservation Release
content:
Buyers who own a Calloway home receive a higher release loyalty percent when they release a Homesite Reservation after the full-refund window. It is read from the buyer's Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage: its owner type and its status.

| Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage | Release loyalty percent |
|---|---|
| owner type original buyer, status active | 75 percent |
| owner type subsequent owner, status active | 60 percent |
| every other buyer | the class's percent of the premium holding fee refunded after the window |

## Combination cases (hypothetical buyers)

- An original buyer whose coverage is active: 75 percent.
- A subsequent owner whose coverage is active: 60 percent.
- An original buyer who sold the home, whose coverage shows status transferred: the class's after-window percent.
- A buyer whose coverage shows status expired: the class's after-window percent.
- A buyer with no Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage: the class's after-window percent.

Both parts of each condition, the owner type and the active status, must be shown together on the coverage record.
